dataset.name: MasakhaNER — Amharic
dataset.notes: Official splits used as released: 1,750/250/500 sentences (25,819/3,749/7,449 tokens). CoNLL BIO tags: PER, ORG, LOC, DATE. LICENCE IS NON-COMMERCIAL (CC BY-NC 4.0), unlike most of the other datasets here; underlying news text carries per-site licences. Any model fine-tuned on it inherits a non-commercial constraint. See docs/DATASET_REDISTRIBUTION.md.
